name: Joe Leffert
fact: The 1989 Talisman photographs him. Printed p. 91 carries a Phonathon picture whose caption names two people: 'Big Red encourages Nashville, Tenn. senior Alyson Hyatt and Madison, Ind. junior Joe Leffert to bring in more money during the Phonathon. $96,215 was raised, topping the $60,000 goal.' Two figures are at the phones. The left one is plainly a woman and would be Hyatt on the usual left-to-right reading; the right one, in glasses, would be Leffert. It is not used, for two reasons: the caption carries no position word, so which figure is which rests on convention alone, and the right-hand face is a blurred three-quarter profile about 90 pixels across with a telephone handset across the jaw. A misidentified face is worse than no face. A later pass with a better scan of this page could revisit it.

name: Cory Hollon
fact: Named in the 1992 Talisman on the Organizations divider, printed p. 153, as a freshman from Evansville, Indiana, and quoted about the debate team. The spread is a photograph of the Garrett Conference Center steps with three student quotations set over it; it carries no portrait of any of the three. This is the only appearance of his name anywhere in the 1989 to 1993 volumes.

name: Amy McLoud
kind: probable duplicate person, flagged not merged
fact: The 1989 Talisman freshman grid, printed p. 147, prints 'Amy McCloud, Hendersonville, Tenn.' and the archive already publishes that face at 1989-90 under the spelling Amy McCloud. The archive holds Amy McLoud (1988-89, on-campus representative) and Amy McCloud (1989-90) as two rows one year apart, and there is only one Amy McCloud in the volume. Almost certainly one woman. No second copy of the face was cut, because the archive's rule is to flag rather than merge and because the Lodmell twins are the standing warning against merging on name similarity. If the editor merges the rows, the existing crop covers both.

name: Mary Sue Bunce
kind: probable duplicate person, flagged not merged
fact: The only Bunce in any of the five volumes is 'Mary S. Bunce, Corp. Comm., Louisville', 1991 Talisman senior grid p. 88, row 4 cell 3, and that face is already published in this block at 1991-92 under the name Mary Susan Bunce. The 1990-91 row named Mary Sue Bunce is almost certainly the same woman. A predecessor on this block considered the point and deliberately filed the crop to one row only; that decision is left standing rather than re-argued.

name: Eric Elliot
kind: probable duplicate person, flagged not merged
fact: The 1990 Talisman underclassmen grid, printed p. 112, prints 'Eric Elliott, (Jr.) Somerset'. That exact cell is already published in this block at 1988-89 under the spelling Eric Elliott. The archive carries Eric Elliot (1989-90) and Eric Elliott (1988-89) as two rows. There is only one Eric Elliott in the volume, so they are the same man. No second copy cut.

name: Kelly Elliot
kind: probable duplicate person, flagged not merged
fact: The 1990 Talisman underclassmen grid, printed p. 112, prints 'Kelly Elliott, (Fr.) Bowling Green', a year earlier than the 1991 sophomore portrait already published in this block at 1990-91 as Kelly Elliott. It is a second, different photograph of the same woman, one year younger. It was not cut, because the identification of the 1989-90 row 'Kelly Elliot' as the same person is exactly the merge a predecessor on this block declined to make. If the editor accepts the merge, the 1990 volume holds a usable second frame at p. 112.

name: Haynes Haddock / Hagan Rose
fact: The 1991 Talisman's Inter-fraternity Council report, p. 202, gives the council's officers for the year: Haynes Haddock president, Duncan Gibson vice president, Todd Mansfield secretary, Hagan Rose treasurer, and Amos Gott, then the ASG president, as adviser. Both Haddock and Hagan Rose sat in SGA as well, and the ASG president advising the IFC is worth recording in its own right.

name: Nita Doshi
kind: found, position certain, identification not confirmed, NOT published
fact: 1992 Talisman p. 218, the first of the four Kappa Delta group photographs. The caption lists sixteen women in rows of five, six and five and the photograph contains exactly sixteen in three clean tiers of five, six and five, so the counting is not in doubt: Doshi is the fourth of the six in the middle row, and the face there is a smiling woman with dark hair and a darker complexion, which fits the name. It is not published because the check failed. The fifth of the same middle row should be Kathleen Young, and the archive already publishes a Kathleen Young from the 1994 Talisman p. 62 with long straight light hair and a fringe; the woman in the fifth position here has darker, curlier hair. Either the row is offset in a way the counting does not reveal, or the archive's Kathleen Young portrait is of someone else. Both possibilities need settling before a face is cut from this frame. Her head is about 30 pixels across in any case.
